games.name: Totally Accurate Tops (Open Alpha)
games.desc:
⚠️ EPILEPSY WARNING ⚠️

A Beyblade physics simulator with custom content. EVERYTHING IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE. The game is in Alpha.

Build a spinning top, bond with spirits to develop signature moves, & battle your friends with (sometimes goofy) physics inspired by the Beyblade metal series!

HOW TO PLAY:
- Click/tap to throw your top
- Battle players and enter tournaments to earn money
- Buy parts and collect spirits from meteors
- Master spirits to unlock Signature Moves

✂️ Attack counters stamina
📄 Stamina counters defense
🪨 Defense counters attack

You gain 30% less experience & cannot gain points in private servers & meteor spawn times are raised to an hour!

⚠️ The game is not done. Data will be wiped before release. Badges earned will give you a head start after the wipe.

- You may need to rejoin for game passes to work

games.name: [HOLIDAYS UPDATE] ULTRA: Rebirth
games.desc:
Welcome to ULTRAMAN: NEO, the definitive Ultraman experience on Roblox! With 200+ playable characters, there's much to explore and learn in this faithful tokusatsu sandbox! Play as fan-favorites like Zero, Tiga, and Mebius, classic kaiju like Gomora and Zetton, unlockable powerhouses like Five King and Ultraman Gruebe, or even the multitudes of characters in our gamepasses! 

CONTROLS:
Shift = sprint
Double jump = hover
Shift while hovering = flight
Double jump + Sprint = flight dash

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Make sure to join our Roblox group at Hikari's Forge for special character unlocks! You may also join our community server to keep up with the latest news, and follow our social media.

games.name: Radiant Residents
games.desc:
[UPDATE 2.1]
-2 new endings/quests for items
-5 new random events
-2 new themes
-New areas
-Medkits can be brought on Expeditions (not hard mode)
-Werewolf and Chicken are back
-New badges
-Bug fixes

Inspired by 60 Seconds, Radiant Residents is a MULTIPLAYER survival horror game where the end of the world has finally come. You have 1 minute to collect items from your house and retreat to the bunker. Beware as disturbing creatures lurk outside the vault. How many days can you survive fighting off these entities? 

WARNING: This game contains sudden jumpscares, loud noises, PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK!
Credits: SmukoZ: Lobby Theme, 60 Seconds Theme, Alt. Vault Theme, Alien Minigame Music, Halloween Vault Theme AJH5704: Vault Theme

Welcome to Energy Assault, a futuristic first person shooter where energy-based guns have replaced ballistic weapons.

🎯 Eliminate your opponents across multiple game modes, including Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Gun Game.
🔫 Level up and earn credits to unlock new guns, attachments, skins, and outfits.
💥 Fulfil your daily missions and claim unique rewards.

games.name: Terminal 13: Not Human [HORROR]
games.desc:
✈️ Welcome to Terminal 13: Not Human

You’ve been assigned to the night shift at Terminal 13. Your job is simple: scan passports, question travelers, and decide who gets through. Keep the terminal clean. Follow every protocol. And whatever you do...
don’t let the wrong ones through.

⚠️ Contains horror elements such as disturbing visuals, tension, and loud sounds.
🎧 Headphones & max graphics recommended for full immersion.

❓ Will you finish your shifts… or be replaced before the morning flight?

❗DISCLAIMER: This game is an independent creation that's unrelated to games from any other platform, but is inspired by Shift At Midnight.
